intent: Visualize quantitative data (trends, comparisons, proportions) as line, bar, pie, radar or gauge charts.
avoid_when: the exact numbers matter more than the shape of the data (use a table or metrics cards)
there are only one or two data points to show (use metrics)
a11y_contract: built on Recharts (SVG rendering) with no built-in text alternative; the caller must supply a surrounding heading, legend text, or aria-label so meaning isn't conveyed by color/shape alone
requires_data: a dataset array shaped for the chosen chart variant (categories/series and numeric values)
